notes.title: Exciting New Content Being Implimented
notes.content:
[h3]Last week we had to announce a delay to the launch of Sempra Infernalis.[/h3]
But, we are pleased to report that our hardware issues are completely resolved and development continues in earnest.

From this day on, in addition to general updates, we will be talking more about specific features and game content in more detail. Today, the Achievement system!

[h3]Constant Progression In Sempra Infernalis[/h3]
Every time you play, you will achieve something. Be it a minor a major milestone. But how does this work in practice?

Every felled enemy drops [b]Essence[/b]. Easier enemies drop less whereas harder foe's drop more, further the value of the essence dropped increases with enemy difficulty. This must be collected by the player by simply passing through its space (running over it). When you die, and yes you will die, lots... all of your progress from that run is lost, except for essence.

This is taken back to your sanctuary and can be used to buy new weapons and items, upgrade existing pieces or to increase your speed, health etc.

[b]Essence[/b] has an additional function though, it acts a proxy for XP. The more you play, the more essence you will collect. That running total of essence collected progresses you through a sliding scale of achievements. So even when you have died for the hundredth time, you may still be able to unlock items to increase your chances of success on the next run.

You might unlock a essence dump, you might unlock a weapon part ([i]keep an eye out for future announcements that will detail how you can build crazy powerful weapons[/i]), a permanent boost to damage or health or your speed. You might also unlock new and unique items not available anywhere else in the game.

We hope that this system is familiar to players (we certainly didn't invent it!) and will keep players having fun for longer. Because that's the focus of this game. To have fun. 

We look forward to you being able to experience this in the near future. If you want more information or want to share your thoughts on this system, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FucNgXYp6Wh]join our discord[/url] and chat with us! We would love to hear from you!

Until the next update, stay safe and enjoy yourselves.

Oliver

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
[h1]Sempra Infernalis was due to release on 16th July 2024. We are pushing that back for a few reasons which we have detailed below. [/h1]

[h3]Before we get into the WHY, we are 110% committed to releasing Sempra Infernalis in the very near future. However we want to ensure that when we do release, you the player has a high quality and enjoyable experience from the outset.[/h3]

[h2]Now onto the WHY…[/h2]

[h3]We have had some hardware related issues…[/h3]
When we planned the development of Sempra Infernalis, we did not account for a major hardware interruption. To say we have been a bit unlucky here is an understatement. However in short, the machines we use to develop Sempra Infernalis need to be replaced. Porting the vast amounts of information over to the new hardware is taking time that we would like to be polishing game mechanics. We have mostly completed this task and will soon be back to finalizing the release version of Sempra Infernalis.

[h3]Some key features are not working as intended…[/h3]
We need more time to address platform optimization to ensure Sempra Infernalis can be enjoyed on the vast majority of PC specifications. In addition to this, some gameplay features are simply taking longer to fine tune and balance than we predicted.

[h3]We want to add more content…[/h3]
Additional enemies and level expansions are currently underway, we had these pinned for free post release patching but due to some projects completing quicker than expected, we have the option to increase the games scope in the early access release version, this means there will be more room for exiting new weapons, enemies, mechanics and environments in the future.

For those that are following development and are adding Sempra Infernalis to your wishlist, we REALLY appreciate the support. Rest assure Sempra Infernalis will release soon.

We can’t wait for you to play and let us know what you think.

If you have any queries or want to know specific information about the development of the game, head over to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FucNgXYp6Wh]THE DISCORD[/url]. We would love to chat with you.

All the best, Oliver

notes.title: Discord Is Live
notes.content:
[h2][url=https://discord.gg/ucNgXYp6Wh]Join The Discord Here![/url][/h2]

[h2]What we will use Discord for[/h2]
This will serve as a hub for players and developers to come together and discuss all things infernal.

Use the discord to:
[list]
[*] Say hello and show your interest in the game
[*] Update us on your escapades through hell - images and videos welcome!
[*] Suggest new features & mechanics or any else you would like to see in the game
[*] Report bugs and glitches
[*] Ask questions about Sempra Infernalis direct to the developers
[/list]

Sempra Infernalis will soft launch on 16th July. We are looking for as much player feedback as possible. Good or bad, we want to hear it.

We hope to catch up with you on the discord soon

Oliver
